scope: Frozen DINOv2 and full-frame cross-check of the first topology-targeted native MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA LoRA
summary: The rank-8 topology smoke adapter slightly improved mean DINO identity but did not repair any of the 100 failing topology frames and regressed worst-frame identity and matched motion, so RSI rejected it and selected the conservative rank-16 round.
evidence: The candidate generated 124/124 frames at 832x480 and 24 FPS with SHA-256 d79e7686e07d0fa79c4191016e5a1c0cfde7b67457b3bb05fd2a163fc09757f4.
Mean DINOv2 reference identity increased from 0.9075820814 to 0.9100687694, but worst-frame identity decreased from 0.8833816648 to 0.8801198900.
Matched motion adherence was 0.9385652028, below the 0.99 non-regression floor; scene and temporal gates passed.
Full-frame semantic review covered 124/124 frames and found 24 passes and 100 hard failures, identical to the backbone baseline passing fraction of 0.1935483871.
The strict assessment selected r2-conservative-r16 with rank 16, learning rate 2e-5, dataset repeat 12, and two epochs.
lessons: Optimizing a small clean-topology curriculum can raise mean appearance similarity without improving the actual shoulder and head-to-torso failure mode.
Worst-frame and full-frame topology evidence are necessary to expose false improvements hidden by averages.
A capability regression should route RSI to the reviewed lower-learning-rate replay round rather than increasing learning rate or declaring success.
limitations: The candidate uses third-party NF4 MiniMax-H3 weights and one held-out real-scene action sequence.
Full-frame topology labels are human semantic judgments bound to the candidate digest, not 3-D anatomy measurements.
This rejected adapter is not a release checkpoint.
next_actions: Complete the bounded r2-conservative-r16 training round on a fresh physical A800 GPU selection.
Repeat the exact held-out generation and promote only on positive topology gain plus all non-regression gates.
